The '''2026 Retro League Event 1''' was the first event of the [[2026 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (1 February – 15 March 2026), played in [[Premiere - Hoth]] format.<ref name="t86468" /> [[Ian Monteith]] won, ahead of [[Brad Kippel]] and [[Bill Bisco]].<ref name="pc2026e1" /><ref name="rl26e1final" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 1 February – 15 March 2026
* '''Players:''' 77
* '''Winner:''' [[Ian Monteith]]

== Final standings ==
The organizer's final results email lists every player in order. The event standings are also the cumulative league standings: 3 points per win and 1 per loss, plus 4 bonus points for first and 2 for second.<ref name="rl26e1final" /> GEMP handles are from the organizer's participant lists and players' pages.<ref name="org2022" /><ref name="org2026" /><ref name="retro-85495" />
